metrics.name: unladenRange
metrics.description: Max single jump with no cargo and just enough fuel for that jump (the headline Coriolis/EDSY jump range).

metrics.name: fullTankRange
metrics.description: Single jump with a full fuel tank and no cargo.

metrics.name: ladenRange
metrics.description: Single jump with full fuel tank and every cargo rack full.

metrics.name: totalRangeUnladen
metrics.description: Total distance on one tank of fuel (consecutive jumps) with no cargo.

metrics.name: totalRangeLaden
metrics.description: Total distance on one tank of fuel with full cargo.

metrics.name: topSpeed
metrics.description: Top speed (4 pips ENG, unladen, full fuel).

metrics.name: topBoost
metrics.description: Boost speed (4 pips ENG, unladen, full fuel). 0 when the distributor cannot boost.

metrics.name: pitch
metrics.description: Pitch rate (4 pips ENG).

metrics.name: yaw
metrics.description: Yaw rate (4 pips ENG).

metrics.name: roll
metrics.description: Roll rate (4 pips ENG).

metrics.name: cargoCapacity
metrics.description: Total cargo rack capacity.

metrics.name: passengerCapacity
metrics.description: Total passenger berths.

metrics.name: fuelCapacity
metrics.description: Main + internal fuel tank capacity.

metrics.name: dryMass
metrics.description: Hull and modules, without fuel or cargo.

metrics.name: ladenMass
metrics.description: Hull + modules + full fuel + full cargo.

metrics.name: totalCost
metrics.description: Purchase price of hull and modules (no discounts, engineering not priced).

metrics.name: powerMargin
metrics.description: Power plant output minus power draw with hardpoints deployed.

metrics.name: fuelScoopRate
metrics.description: Fuel scoop rate at a main-sequence star.

metrics.name: refineryBins
metrics.description: Refinery bins.

metrics.name: collectorLimpets
metrics.description: Simultaneously active collector limpets (collector + multi-limpet controllers).

metrics.name: shieldRaw
metrics.description: Shield strength (generator + boosters + guardian SRPs), no resistances.

metrics.name: shieldEHP
metrics.description: Effective shield HP against the context damage mix at the context SYS pips (resistances incl. diminishing returns).

metrics.name: shieldEHPWithCells
metrics.description: shieldEHP plus total shield cell bank capacity.

metrics.name: shieldRecharge
metrics.description: Seconds to recharge shields from 50% to 100% at the recovery SYS pips (context.recoverySys).

metrics.name: shieldRecover
metrics.description: Seconds from shields broken back to 50% at the recovery SYS pips (includes 16 s delay).

metrics.name: shieldRegen
metrics.description: Shield regeneration the distributor can sustain indefinitely at the fighting SYS pips.

metrics.name: shieldSustainDps
metrics.description: Raw incoming DPS (context damage mix and SYS pips) the shields absorb indefinitely: sustained regeneration divided by the damage multiplier. Rewards high resistances, which multiply the value of every MJ regenerated.

metrics.name: shieldTimeUnderFire
metrics.description: Seconds until shields break under context.incomingDps raw damage (context mix and SYS pips); regeneration counts for the context.regenUnderFire share of the time (default 0). 1e6 = never.

metrics.name: shieldTimeUnderFireWithCells
metrics.description: shieldTimeUnderFire with all shield cell bank MJ added to the pool (ignores spin-up and heat).

metrics.name: shieldEHPWorstType
metrics.description: Effective shield HP against whichever of kinetic/thermal/explosive the shield resists least, at context SYS pips. Exposes the stock -20% thermal hole that a mixed average hides.

metrics.name: hullRaw
metrics.description: Armour (bulkheads + hull reinforcements), no resistances.

metrics.name: hullEHP
metrics.description: Effective armour against the context damage mix.

metrics.name: totalEHP
metrics.description: shieldEHP + hullEHP: total effective damage absorbed before destruction (no cells).

metrics.name: totalEHPWithCells
metrics.description: totalEHP plus shield cell bank capacity.

metrics.name: moduleArmour
metrics.description: Total integrity of module reinforcement packages: the damage they absorb before they are used up (protection share is moduleProtection).

metrics.name: moduleProtection
metrics.description: Share of module damage absorbed by module reinforcements.

metrics.name: sustainedDps
metrics.description: Raw sustained DPS of all weapons including reloads (no target resistances).

metrics.name: burstDps
metrics.description: Raw burst DPS of all weapons (no reloads).

metrics.name: dpsVsShields
metrics.description: Sustained DPS against the reference opponent's shields at context range (resistances, falloff).

metrics.name: dpsVsHull
metrics.description: Sustained DPS against the reference opponent's hull at context range (resistances, hardness/piercing, falloff, Corrosive Shell debuff).

metrics.name: pierceEfficiency
metrics.description: DPS-weighted share of hull damage that survives the reference opponent's armour hardness (piercing/hardness, capped at 1). Rewards Focused engineering and piercing-100 weapons against big hulls.

metrics.name: timeToKill
metrics.description: Seconds to strip the reference opponent's shields (at its SYS pips) and then its hull at the context range; opponent regeneration ignored. 1e6 = cannot.

metrics.name: boostInterval
metrics.description: Seconds between boosts at 4 ENG pips (distributor refill or the hull's boost cooldown, whichever is longer). 1e6 = cannot boost.

metrics.name: weaponSustain
metrics.description: Seconds of continuous fire before the WEP capacitor is empty at context WEP pips (capped at 1e6 = sustainable).

metrics.name: emptyHardpoints
metrics.description: Weapon hardpoints left empty. Constrain to 0 for a fully armed ship.

metrics.name: emptyUtilities
metrics.description: Utility mounts left empty.

metrics.name: powerAvailable
metrics.description: Power plant output.

metrics.name: combatPowerDraw
metrics.description: Power drawn in a fight: every combat module with hardpoints deployed (non-combat modules shed by priority).

metrics.name: powerPlantHeat
metrics.description: Heat the power plant generates in a fight: combat power draw x the plant's heat efficiency. Low Emissions, Armoured and Thermal Spread lower it; Overcharged raises it.

metrics.name: combatHeat
metrics.description: Net heat per second in a fight: power plant heat plus weapon heat, minus what Thermal Vent beams remove while on target (context.ventHitRate, context.thermalVentFactor). Negative = the ship cools while firing. Thrusters and FSD charging are not included (no data); the hull's own dissipation is not modelled, so compare builds of the same hull.

metrics.name: thermalVentRemoval
metrics.description: Heat per second Thermal Vent beams remove while on target (assumed thermalVentFactor x their thermal load, reduced by falloff).

metrics.name: thermalVentBreakEven
metrics.description: Thermal Vent strength (multiple of the vent beams' own thermal load) needed to cancel all other heat in a fight. If your ship reaches 0 heat with vents on target, the real factor is at least this. 1e6 = no vent beams.

metrics.name: weaponTypes
metrics.description: Number of distinct weapon types fitted (e.g. plasma accelerators + multi-cannons = 2). Cap it to keep a loadout with matching ballistics that is easy to aim and manage.

metrics.name: mountTypes
metrics.description: Number of distinct mount types among weapons (fixed, gimballed, turreted). 1 = all weapons share one mount type.

metrics.name: weaponHeat
metrics.description: Heat generated per second by all weapons firing (Coriolis thermal load). Cap it at a proven build's value to avoid overheating loadouts.

metrics.name: ammoEndurance
metrics.description: Seconds of continuous fire until the first ammunition-limited weapon runs completely dry (magazine + reserve; 1e6 = no ammo-limited weapons). Pair with DPS goals so finite ordnance is not mistaken for sustained damage.

metrics.name: axSustainedDps
metrics.description: Raw sustained DPS from AX/Guardian (experimental) weapons only — the damage that counts against Thargoid interceptors.

parametrised: count:<group> = number of fitted modules of a group
class:<group> = sum of classes of fitted modules of a group
result.context: Effective-HP metrics use context.damage/damagePreset and sysPips; shieldTimeUnderFire uses incomingDps and regenUnderFire; dpsVs*, pierceEfficiency and timeToKill use context.opponent and rangeMeters; weaponSustain uses wepPips; jump ranges use reserveFuelInJumpMass.
result.assumptions: Defaults that no published measurement settles: the pve damage mix, regenUnderFire=0, thermalVentFactor=1, the Corrosive Shell 1.25 hull multiplier and +20 piercing (community figures), reserve fuel excluded from jump mass, Coriolis hull-resistance stacking. Rerun with the alternative when a ranking is close.

specials.name: Deep Charge
specials.description: Toughened FSD power conduits and a reinforced charging field increase the amount of fuel injected when charging, allowing larger jumps at the cost of increased power draw.

specials.name: Mass Manager
specials.description: Complex software upgrade and internal sensor suite able to optimise frame shift operation by analysing and accounting for ship loadout. Increases optimised mass at the cost of module health.

specials.name: Double Braced
specials.description: Additional, hardened supports and bracing further improve module survivability.

specials.name: Stripped Down
specials.description: Key components replaced with versions crafted from lightweight materials and all extraneous parts removed entirely to reduce mass.

specials.name: Thermal Spread
specials.description: Additional thermal conduits and radiator solutions integrated across the module help balance thermal load increase cooling potential.

specials.name: Thermo Block
specials.description: Improved feedback protection and reinforced projection nodes increase resistance to thermal damage, at the cost of overall shield strength.

specials.name: Force Block
specials.description: Enlarged projection nodes increase resistance to kinetic damage, at the cost of overall shield strength.

specials.name: Blast Block
specials.description: Advanced field resonation patterns increase resistance to explosive damage, at the cost of overall shield strength.

specials.name: Flow Control
specials.description: Advanced software and internal sensors regulate energy flow more efficiently, reducing module power draw.

specials.name: Double Braced
specials.description: Additional, hardened supports and bracing further improve module survivability.

specials.name: Super Capacitors
specials.description: Additional, advanced capacitors increases overall shield strength at the cost of damage resistance.

specials.name: Dazzle shell
specials.description: Experimental shells that temporarily reduce a target's sensor acuity upon impact.

specials.name: Dispersal field
specials.description: Experimental upgrade that causes successful strikes to temporarily confuse all gimbal and turret hardpoints on the target, at the cost of direct damage potential.

specials.name: Phasing sequence
specials.description: Modulating burst fire system designed to defeat shielding. A small amount of damage is able to bleed through shields and attack the target's hull directly, at the cost of minor damage reduction.

specials.name: Plasma slug (Legacy)
specials.description: Experimental upgrade allowing plasma slug ammo to be generated directly from ship fuel, at the cost of reduced damage.

specials.name: Plasma Slug

specials.name: Target lock breaker
specials.description: Experimental upgrade that breaks target lock on successful strikes.

specials.name: Thermal conduit

specials.name: Oversized
specials.description: Scaled up components and reinforced munitions housing allows the weapon to pack more of a punch, increasing damage at the cost of increased power draw.

specials.name: Flow Control

specials.name: Multi-servos
